import bpy
import mathutils

# 带坡度的直管段:两端高差由坡度推出,沿两井位连线铺设
coll = bpy.data.collections.get('seg_pipe') or bpy.data.collections.new('seg_pipe')
if 'seg_pipe' not in [c.name for c in bpy.context.scene.collection.children]:
    bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)

start = mathutils.Vector((0.0, 0.0, -3.0))
end = mathutils.Vector((40.0, 0.0, -3.4))  # 1‰ 坡度 → 0.4m 落差
direction = end - start
length = direction.length
center = (start + end) / 2

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.2, depth=length, location=center)
pipe = bpy.context.active_object
pipe.name = 'seg_pipe_main'
pipe.rotation_euler = direction.to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()
coll.objects.link(pipe)

mat = bpy.data.materials.new('pipe_concrete')
mat.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (0.45, 0.45, 0.42, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.8
pipe.data.materials.append(mat)

import bpy
import mathutils

# 检查井:井室圆筒 + 收口锥 + 井盖,多子对象拆分
coll = bpy.data.collections.get('mh_node') or bpy.data.collections.new('mh_node')
if 'mh_node' not in [c.name for c in bpy.context.scene.collection.children]:
    bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)

base = mathutils.Vector((0.0, 0.0, -3.0))

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.6, depth=2.4, location=base + mathutils.Vector((0, 0, 1.2)))
chamber = bpy.context.active_object
chamber.name = 'mh_node_chamber'
coll.objects.link(chamber)

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(radius1=0.6, radius2=0.3, depth=0.6, location=base + mathutils.Vector((0, 0, 2.7)))
taper = bpy.context.active_object
taper.name = 'mh_node_taper'
coll.objects.link(taper)

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.32, depth=0.08, location=base + mathutils.Vector((0, 0, 3.04)))
cover = bpy.context.active_object
cover.name = 'mh_node_cover'
coll.objects.link(cover)

mat = bpy.data.materials.new('manhole_cast_iron')
mat.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = 0.85
bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.45
chamber.data.materials.append(mat)
taper.data.materials.append(mat)
cover.data.materials.append(mat)

import bpy
import mathutils

# 阀件:阀体 + 阀杆 + 手轮,至少拆 3 个子对象

import bpy
import mathutils

# 批量阵列:同型构件沿直线等距复制(如灯杆/套管排布),循环内统一 link 进范围集合
coll = bpy.data.collections.get('array_posts') or bpy.data.collections.new('array_posts')
if 'array_posts' not in [c.name for c in bpy.context.scene.collection.children]:
    bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)

spacing = 10.0
count = 6
for i in range(count):
    x = i * spacing
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.08, depth=6.0, location=mathutils.Vector((x, 1.5, 0.0)))
    post = bpy.context.active_object
    post.name = f'array_posts_{i:02d}'
    coll.objects.link(post)

bpy.context.scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE'

import bpy
import mathutils

# 道路地面:细分平面 + 高程微扰(模拟路面),材质深沥青
coll = bpy.data.collections.get('street_surface') or bpy.data.collections.new('street_surface')
if 'street_surface' not in [c.name for c in bpy.context.scene.collection.children]:
    bpy.context.scene.collection.children.link(coll)

bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=120.0, location=mathutils.Vector((20.0, 0.0, 0.0)))
ground = bpy.context.active_object
ground.name = 'street_surface_main'
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='EDIT')
bpy.ops.mesh.subdivide(number_cuts=4)
bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode='OBJECT')
coll.objects.link(ground)

mat = bpy.data.materials.new('asphalt')
mat.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes['Principled BSDF']
bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (0.08, 0.08, 0.09, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.95
ground.data.materials.append(mat)

bpy.context.scene.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE'
